summary.text: Steve Bartels is a Republican state representative from Indiana House District 74 who was appointed to the seat in November 2017 and is seeking re-election on November 3, 2026.
Ballotpedia lists Democrat Lena Goffinet as his opponent in the general election.

paragraphs.text: Steve Bartels was born and raised in southern Indiana.

Ballotpedia says he served in the U.S. military for 22 years and as a full-time Indiana law enforcement officer for nine years, and that he owned and operated Patoka Lake Marina, Inc., and Patoka Lake Winery, Inc.
He also served on the county tourism board and the Crawford County Council.
Bartels was appointed to the House on November 6, 2017, after the resignation of Lloyd Arnold.
For 2025-2026, Ballotpedia lists him as chair of the Veterans Affairs and Public Safety Committee and as a member of the Courts and Criminal Code and House Public Policy committees.
